newsitem.title: USA: Porta Systems, British Telecoms amend pact.
newsitem.headline: Porta Systems, British Telecoms amend pact.

text.p: Porta Systems Corp said Thursday its long-term supply contract with British Telecommunications Plc was amended to cut prices on equipment Porta Systems sells to BT and to end its exclusivity in the supply of the equipment covered in the contract.
The contract covers the sale to BT of connector blocks, protector modules and other equipment.
Porta Systems announced separately Thursday that it signed a separate contract with BT worth about $4.3 million to supply BT with Operations Support Systems (OSS) equipment.
Porta Systems' OSS products automate telephone operations, efficiently manage line growth, improve repair efficiency and, using computer analyses, anticipate circuit faults before they occur.
Porta Systems also reported, as it had previously, that it does not currently satisfy all of the American Stock Exchange's financial guidelines for continued listing of its common stock.
"In the event that this situation is not remedied, there can be no assurance that the listing of its common stock will continue," the company said.
Porta Systems designs, manufactures, markets and supports communications equipment used in voice, video and data networks worldwide.
